source.version: arXiv:2604.09200v1; version header 10 Apr 2026; Original resource captured 2026-10-28T07:24:42.562048+00:00; sha256:e40ba950b22fcc1af8411caaaf1bd7f478a77d16e3eecc8e9a7cf81a919e4ae5

label.en: NUWA research note · independent review pending
label.zh: NUWA 研究解读 · 独立复核待完成

en.takeaway: Attitudinal effects cannot be assumed to predict behavioral effects.
en.question: Does conversational persuasion change completed political action as well as stated attitudes?
en.design: The study reports 17,950 responses from 14,779 people and separates attitudes from completed political behaviour. Petition signing is an observed completion endpoint rather than stated willingness.
findings: The reported treatment effect on petition signing was 19.7 percentage points. Attitude effects and behavioural effects were not reliably correlated across the studied comparisons.
en.interpretation: Attitude change cannot simply substitute for action. Signing, donating, willingness and attitudes should remain distinct outcomes rather than one persuasion success rate.
en.limits: The observed lack of a reliable correlation does not prove zero association in every setting. Participant and response counts differ because participation spans studies.
en.decisionRelevance: NUWA recommendation: Use as behavioural evidence alongside attitude studies, keeping the intervention, comparator and action endpoint explicit.

zh.takeaway: 17,950 个回答来自 14,779 人；实际签署请愿的效应示例为 +19.7 个百分点，态度与行为效应未发现显著相关。
zh.question: 态度变化能否预测真实签名行为？
zh.design: 研究汇集 17,950 份回应、14,779 名参与者，分别记录态度和完成的政治行为。请愿签署使用实际完成的终点，而非只询问参与意愿。
findings: 请愿实际签署的报告处理效应为 19.7 个百分点。在所研究对比中，态度效应与行为效应未呈现可靠相关；不据此外推为所有情境中均无关联。
zh.interpretation: 态度改变不能直接充当行为代理；研究者应分别保留签署、捐赠、意愿和态度，避免合成一个说服成功率。
zh.limits: 特定招募样本、议题和界面；未发现关联不证明所有情境均无关联。
zh.decisionRelevance: NUWA 建议：为人类影响结果增设实际行为终点，不用模型自评替代。

source.version: arXiv:2507.13919v1; version header 18 Jul 2025; Original resource captured 2026-10-28T07:24:42.799243+00:00; sha256:d5b281b13ed3337e92d2f7295a10191cd21141416b1a1b39191bbfa45e2dca07

label.en: NUWA research note · independent review pending
label.zh: NUWA 研究解读 · 独立复核待完成

en.takeaway: Scale effects depend on training strata; model size alone does not explain persuasion.
en.question: How do scale and post-training relate to conversational political persuasion?
en.design: The study relates persuasion to effective pretraining compute, measured in FLOPs and partly estimated for proprietary models. Chat-tuned and developer-post-trained strata are reported separately. Compute is not total parameter count.
findings: For chat-tuned systems, the association was 1.83 percentage points per tenfold compute increase (95% Bayesian credible interval 1.42–2.25). The developer-post-trained estimate was 0.32 points (−1.18–1.85), crossing zero.
en.interpretation: Model size can be a descriptive chart attribute, but this compute association is not a causal effect of total parameters on risk. Post-training differences remain material.
en.limits: The strata are heterogeneous and proprietary compute estimates are uncertain. An association with compute is not a matched intervention on model parameters.
en.decisionRelevance: NUWA recommendation: Keep compute, total parameters and post-training as separate metadata when interpreting persuasion or model-size plots.

zh.takeaway: 规模自变量是有效预训练计算量（FLOPs），闭源模型使用估计值；聊天微调与厂商后训练分层的关联不同，后者区间跨零。不能替换为总参数量。
zh.question: 尺寸、后训练和提示分别如何影响说服？
zh.design: 研究比较不同训练条件中的说服表现与有效预训练计算量。规模变量为 FLOPs，部分专有模型计算量采用来源估计，并非模型总参数量；聊天微调与开发者后训练分层报告。
findings: 聊天微调组每十倍有效预训练计算量与 1.83 个百分点说服差异相关（95% 贝叶斯可信区间 1.42–2.25）；开发者后训练组为 0.32（−1.18–1.85），区间跨零。
zh.interpretation: 模型尺寸可以作为图上的描述性属性，但这里的计算量关联不能作为总参数量与风险之间的因果效应，也不能忽略后训练差异。
zh.limits: 受控关联分析仍依赖模型规模口径与训练信息；不可将相对提升百分比与百分点混用。
zh.decisionRelevance: NUWA 建议：作为点大小图的反向约束：展示分布，避免拟合未经条件匹配的尺寸—风险曲线。

source.title: Training language models to be warm can reduce accuracy and increase sycophancy

label.en: NUWA research note · independent review pending
label.zh: NUWA 研究解读 · 独立复核待完成

en.takeaway: Style adaptation can affect factual behavior; it is not an invariant cosmetic change.
en.question: Can training a warmer conversational style change accuracy and agreement with user errors?
en.design: The study compares warm-style trained models with their original counterparts and varies whether user prompts include an incorrect belief and emotion. The training intervention and prompt conditions are distinct variables.
findings: The warm-minus-original error gap was 12.1 percentage points when incorrect beliefs and emotions were appended, compared with 6.8 points without appended beliefs or emotions.
en.interpretation: Conversational-style training can change safety-relevant behaviour. Equal model scale does not imply equal propensity; training and interaction conditions belong in the evidence record.
en.limits: These are specific interventions and prompt distributions, not a universal effect of friendly language. The two context conditions are not interchangeable.
en.decisionRelevance: NUWA recommendation: Link interface and post-training interventions to measures of accuracy and sycophancy rather than inferring behaviour from size alone.

zh.takeaway: 错误用户信念加情绪提示时，温暖模型相对原模型的误差差距为 12.1 个百分点，另有无附加信念情绪条件 6.8 个百分点。
zh.question: 交互风格训练是否改变准确性与附和行为？
zh.design: 研究比较训练后温暖风格模型与原模型的准确性和迎合表现，并改变用户是否陈述错误信念及情绪。训练干预与提示条件分开解释。
findings: 附加错误信念与情绪时，温暖模型相对原模型的错误差异为 12.1 个百分点；没有附加信念和情绪时为 6.8 个百分点。
zh.interpretation: 面向用户的风格训练本身可能改变安全相关行为。模型规模相同也不意味着倾向相同，需要记录训练与交互条件。
zh.limits: 特定训练干预及任务条件；风格、后训练、上下文都可能混淆简单规模解释。
zh.decisionRelevance: NUWA 建议：连接模型后训练与使用情境，不把不同风格版本视为同一个被测系统。

summary.zh: 同一模型跨接口比较；实机末端控制 612 次试验报告 18% 拒绝，关节控制 252 次报告 41%，两者不能合并为单一能力序。

source.version: arXiv:2610.14043v1; version header 03 Oct 2026; Original resource captured 2026-10-28T07:24:43.704880+00:00; sha256:c5b843fd1a59541e7c7713423f4c765813de1b6dc8cb85bc7aa5913c0c945572

label.en: NUWA research note · independent review pending
label.zh: NUWA 研究解读 · 独立复核待完成

en.takeaway: Text refusal and embodied action safety measure different failure paths.
en.question: Does a refusal observed in chat persist when the model controls a robot?
en.design: The study compares chat with robot-control interfaces and separates real-robot end-effector and joint-control settings. The real-robot conditions involve different interface/model populations, with separate trial counts.
findings: Reported refusal was 18% across 612 real end-effector trials and 41% across 252 real joint-control trials. These are rounded refusal rates, not rates of executed physical harm.
en.interpretation: Chat refusal is interface-specific behavioural evidence, not a sufficient condition for safe physical action. Refusal, execution and resulting damage are different endpoints.
en.limits: The settings are not a matched model-only comparison. Rounded rates do not identify exact refusal numerators, and refusal is not a physical harm measurement.
en.decisionRelevance: NUWA recommendation: Pair hazard recognition with action-level evaluation; retain the interface, embodiment and outcome definition.

zh.takeaway: 同一模型跨接口比较；实机末端控制 612 次试验报告 18% 拒绝，关节控制 252 次报告 41%，两者不能合并为单一能力序。
zh.question: 文本拒答能否迁移至机器人行动接口？
zh.design: 研究比较聊天与机器人控制接口，并区分真实机器人的末端执行器接口和关节接口。两个真实机器人条件的模型与接口总体不同，分别保留试验次数。
findings: 真实机器人的末端执行器接口拒绝率为 18%（612 次试验），关节接口为 41%（252 次试验）。这些是舍入的拒绝率，不是实际执行物理危害的发生率。
zh.interpretation: 聊天拒答是接口特定的行为证据，不能作为物理行动安全的充分条件。拒绝、执行和造成损伤是不同终点。
zh.limits: 少量设计场景、特定机器人与接口；拒答既受危险识别也受控制能力影响，未拒绝不等于已造成伤害。
zh.decisionRelevance: NUWA 建议：与 ASIMOV 的危险识别、Palisade 的关闭行为形成互补测量。

label.en: NUWA research note · independent review pending
label.zh: NUWA 研究解读 · 独立复核待完成

en.takeaway: Task completion must be reported alongside damage-aware outcomes.
en.question: Can a manipulation policy complete its task while damaging its environment?
en.design: DamageSim adds damage signals to manipulation simulation and evaluates damage-aware policies in two simulation environments. Task completion and damage are interpreted jointly rather than reduced to success alone.
findings: The benchmark makes damage-aware outcomes visible alongside task completion and explores uses for safe policy training and sim-to-real evaluation.
en.interpretation: A successful manipulation can still be unsafe. Damage proxies broaden the construct, while transfer from simulated signals to real damage still needs calibration.
en.limits: Damage depends on simulator physics and thresholds. Simulation cost is neither human-harm probability nor complete coverage of real materials and contacts.
en.decisionRelevance: NUWA recommendation: Assess calibration of each damage signal and report task completion separately from physical-cost proxies.

zh.takeaway: DamageSim 将损伤信号纳入模拟评测，跨两种模拟环境展示安全策略和 sim-to-real 用途。
zh.question: 任务完成时是否损坏机器人或环境？
zh.design: DamageSim 在操作任务模拟中加入损伤信号，并在两种模拟环境中评估损伤感知策略。任务完成与损伤同时解释，而非只保留成功分数。
findings: 基准把损伤感知结果与任务完成并列，探索安全策略训练和仿真到真实的用途。没有在本批新增可与既有排行榜直接合并的数值单元。
zh.interpretation: 成功的操作也可能不安全。损伤代理拓展了评测构念，但从仿真信号到真实损伤仍需校准证据。
zh.limits: 损伤取决于物理模型和阈值；模拟成本不是人类伤害概率，不代表所有真实接触与材料。
zh.decisionRelevance: NUWA 建议：补充损伤代理与真实损伤之间的校准证据。

label.en: NUWA research note · independent review pending
label.zh: NUWA 研究解读 · 独立复核待完成

en.takeaway: A four-quadrant success/safety decomposition avoids hiding unsafe successes.
en.question: How do structural, language and visual perturbations affect embodied safety?
en.design: The protocol covers 13 safety categories, 66 base scenarios and five embodiments. Language and visual variations overlay the base scenarios. Outcomes separate safe success, safe failure, unsafe success and unsafe failure, with cumulative safety cost and exposure measures.
findings: The four-quadrant decomposition exposes unsafe successes that a task-success scalar can hide. The scenario and category counts describe benchmark design, not observed harm frequency.
en.interpretation: Process and endpoint evidence need joint interpretation. Composite metrics should retain inspectable components so that high completion does not conceal unsafe action.
en.limits: Overlay variants are not additional independent base tasks. Results depend on simulation safety thresholds and the evaluated embodiments.
en.decisionRelevance: NUWA recommendation: Compare safety components within a shared embodiment and configuration, preserving base-scenario and perturbation identities.

zh.takeaway: 13 类分类、66 个基础场景、5 种具身；联合报告安全/不安全成功与失败，另有累计安全成本和风险暴露时间。
zh.question: 结构、语言、视觉变化分别如何影响具身安全？
zh.design: 协议覆盖 13 类安全问题、66 个基础场景和 5 种具身；语言与视觉变化叠加在基础场景上。结果区分安全成功、安全失败、不安全成功和不安全失败，并辅以累计安全成本与风险暴露指标。
findings: 安全／不安全与成功／失败的四象限分解能够揭示任务成功率隐藏的不安全成功；场景和类别数量描述基准设计，不代表现实危害频率。
zh.interpretation: 过程与终点需要共同解释；综合指标应保留可检查的分量，不能让高任务完成度抵消不安全行为。
zh.limits: 语言和视觉变化叠加在基础场景上，不是另外新增的独立任务；指标依赖仿真安全阈值。
zh.decisionRelevance: NUWA 建议：为物理安全页面补充过程指标，保留原始分量，避免只采用综合标量。

label.en: NUWA research note · independent review pending
label.zh: NUWA 研究解读 · 独立复核待完成

en.takeaway: Cross-domain trends require methodology-specific interpretation and negative-evidence limits.
en.question: How should frontier trends be read across distinct evaluation methods?
en.design: The official report juxtaposes question answering, long tasks, agent evaluation, expert red teaming and human studies, discussing their methodological blind spots. Included studies retain their original experimental identity.
findings: The report describes no observable spontaneous sandbagging in more than 2,700 monitored transcripts, while acknowledging black-box limitations. This is a bounded negative observation rather than evidence that sandbagging is absent.
en.interpretation: A cross-domain report can organise questions and evidence chains, but methods and detection sensitivity must remain explicit. Non-detection does not establish absence.
en.limits: The report is not an independent replication of its component studies. Black-box and trace-based observations may miss unobservable strategies.
en.decisionRelevance: NUWA recommendation: Use its method taxonomy to connect records and identify missing evidence without pooling heterogeneous scores.

zh.takeaway: 汇总 QA、长任务、智能体、专家红队和人类研究；对 2,700 余条轨迹未发现可观测的自发藏拙，同时承认黑箱盲点。
zh.question: 多领域趋势如何与评测方法对应？
zh.design: 官方报告将问答、长任务、智能体评测、专家红队与人类研究并置，并讨论方法盲点。汇总结果保留原实验身份，本次不将被引用研究再计为独立复现。
findings: 报告在 2,700 余条受监测轨迹中未观察到自发藏拙，同时承认黑箱局限。这是有范围的未检出观察，不能证明藏拙不存在。
zh.interpretation: 跨领域报告适合组织研究问题与证据链；各章节的测量工具和检出能力必须保留，未检出不能直接等同于不存在。
zh.limits: 系列汇总不能当作独立复现；未检出链式思维证据不证明无藏拙。
zh.decisionRelevance: NUWA 建议：为既有 RepliBench、网络场景和说服条目补充跨域上下文及反证。

source.title: Long-Form Tasks: A Methodology for Evaluating Scientific Assistants

label.en: NUWA research note · independent review pending
label.zh: NUWA 研究解读 · 独立复核待完成

en.takeaway: Long-form evaluation is a bridge toward human-utility measurement, not a replacement for uplift trials.
en.question: How well do long-form scientific tasks proxy the usefulness of an assistant?
en.design: The methods article combines open-ended long tasks, expert rubrics and model grading as a scalable proxy for human-uplift studies. This record retains evaluation design and validity boundaries, without operational task material.
findings: Long-form tasks can assess a richer workflow than knowledge questions, but automatic grading does not by itself establish successful laboratory work or human misuse uplift.
en.interpretation: Knowledge, planning, tool use and human uplift are distinct evidence layers. Long tasks can extend question-answer coverage without replacing the corresponding human study.
en.limits: Rubric and model-judge validity remain assumptions to test. A proxy outcome is not an observed experimental or real-world harm outcome.
en.decisionRelevance: NUWA recommendation: Locate the missing links between question answering, long-form task performance and measured human uplift.

zh.takeaway: 将开放长任务、专家规则与模型判分作为人类增益试验的可扩展代理。
zh.question: 知识问答能否代表科研助手效用？
zh.design: 方法介绍把开放长任务、专家规则和模型判分结合，作为人类增益试验的可扩展代理。本次仅收录任务设计、判分依赖与外推边界，不复述危险任务材料。
findings: 长任务能够覆盖比知识问答更丰富的工作流，但自动评分本身不能确立实际实验成功或人类恶意使用增益。
zh.interpretation: 知识、规划、工具使用和人类增益是不同证据层。长任务可弥补问答覆盖不足，不能替代对应的人类研究。
zh.limits: 长任务仍是代理；自动评分不建立实际实验成功或恶意使用增益。
zh.decisionRelevance: NUWA 建议：按 QA—规划—工具能力—人类增益拆开证据链。

source.title: Impact of modeling assumptions on time horizon results

label.en: NUWA research note · independent review pending
label.zh: NUWA 研究解读 · 独立复核待完成

en.takeaway: Saturation amplifies sensitivity to model assumptions; time-horizon revisions are not capability regressions.
en.question: How sensitive are time-horizon estimates to statistical assumptions near saturation?
en.design: The authors’ research note examines regularisation corrections, fitted curves, task distribution and human-duration noise, distinguishing sampling uncertainty from model-choice sensitivity.
findings: Some frontier horizon estimates change materially under plausible modelling choices, particularly as the task suite approaches saturation. A methods correction is not an observed model capability regression.
en.interpretation: Each horizon estimate needs its method version and task distribution. Error bars do not automatically cover model-choice uncertainty, and extrapolation is not observed continuous autonomous runtime.
en.limits: The research note has less review than a formal METR blog. Conclusions concern the evaluated task distribution and fitting assumptions.
en.decisionRelevance: NUWA recommendation: Use for version and sensitivity notes on the existing Time Horizons record; do not overwrite historical observations.

zh.takeaway: 说明正则化修正、任务分布、拟合曲线与人类时长噪声；合理模型变化对部分前沿估计影响较大。
zh.question: 任务集接近饱和时，统计建模会怎样改变跨度估计？
zh.design: 作者研究笔记比较正则化修正、拟合形式、任务分布和人类时长误差对跨度估计的影响，并区分抽样不确定性与建模选择。
findings: 部分前沿跨度估计在合理建模选择下有明显变化，任务集接近饱和时尤其如此。方法修正不是观察到的模型能力下降。
zh.interpretation: 每个跨度点都应绑定方法版本与任务分布。误差条不能自动覆盖所有建模选择，超出任务范围的拟合也不是直接观测到的连续运行时长。
zh.limits: 作者研究笔记经过的审阅少于正式博文；区间反映抽样与模型选择的边界不同。
zh.decisionRelevance: NUWA 建议：为现有跨度图增加方法修订关系和版本绑定。

source.title: Clarifying limitations of time horizon

label.en: NUWA research note · independent review pending
label.zh: NUWA 研究解读 · 独立复核待完成

en.takeaway: Time horizons do not directly identify research speedup or economic automation.
en.question: What separates a time-horizon estimate from research speedup or economic automation?
en.design: The authors’ limitations note discusses success probability versus human task duration and the costs of prompting, waiting, checking and repair. It is an interpretation of the metric, not a new labour-substitution experiment.
findings: A fitted horizon does not directly identify research speedup or economic automation. Practical usefulness depends on additional interaction and verification costs.
en.interpretation: The capability measure informs task feasibility; actual usefulness still requires measurements of use and cost. A duration axis does not cover the context demands of every job.
en.limits: The note is bounded by the current task distribution and does not establish effects across all economic work or high-context roles.
en.decisionRelevance: NUWA recommendation: Keep capability, usefulness and controllability separate in autonomy narratives and safety arguments.

zh.takeaway: 完成概率对人类任务时长的拟合不能直接转成研发提速；还需测提示、等待、检查和人工修补。
zh.question: 跨度指标与实际劳动替代或研发提速相隔什么？
zh.design: 作者限制说明讨论任务成功概率与人类任务时长的关系，以及提示、等待、检查、人工修补等使用成本。它是指标解释，不是新的劳动替代实验。
findings: 拟合跨度不能直接确定研发提速或经济自动化效果；实际效用还依赖额外交互和验证成本。
zh.interpretation: 能力指标可以提供任务可行性证据，实际效用仍需要使用场景和成本测量。不同岗位的上下文需求不能被一个时长轴覆盖。
zh.limits: 研究笔记与当前任务分布；不能覆盖全部经济工作或高语境岗位。
zh.decisionRelevance: NUWA 建议：补充从任务能力到使用效用的外推假设。

source.title: HiBayES: Improving LLM evaluation with hierarchical Bayesian modelling

label.en: NUWA research note · independent review pending
label.zh: NUWA 研究解读 · 独立复核待完成

en.takeaway: Nested evaluation structure belongs in the uncertainty model.
en.question: How should nested evaluation units enter an uncertainty model?
en.design: The official methods article uses hierarchical Bayesian modelling to represent nested variation across items, repeated runs and raters, including partial pooling. This reading covers the article, not a complete paper and code audit.
findings: Nested models can distinguish sources of evaluation variability that a simple pooled mean hides, while introducing assumptions about hierarchy, priors and pooling.
en.interpretation: Uncertainty should follow sampling and dependence structure. A more complex model is not automatically more reliable; priors, diagnostics and misspecification still matter.
en.limits: Bayesian credible intervals are not automatically frequentist confidence intervals. Hierarchical assumptions and partial pooling require validation.
en.decisionRelevance: NUWA recommendation: Register task, run and rater units with interval kind and method before aggregating repeated evaluation results.

zh.takeaway: 层次贝叶斯建模显式处理嵌套结构与多类结果，支持比简单均值更细的推断。
zh.question: 重复运行、题目差异和评审差异如何进入不确定性？
zh.design: 官方方法介绍通过层次贝叶斯模型组织题目、重复运行及评审等嵌套变化，并讨论部分汇聚。本次选读官方介绍，未声称完成其全部论文和代码审计。
findings: 嵌套模型有助于区分简单汇总均值掩盖的变异来源，但同时引入层级结构、先验与部分汇聚假设。
zh.interpretation: 不确定性应与实际抽样和依赖结构相符；更复杂的模型不是自动更可靠，仍需检查先验、后验诊断和模型错设。
zh.limits: 模型假设、先验和部分汇聚仍须诊断；可信区间不可自动解释为频率学置信区间。
zh.decisionRelevance: NUWA 建议：将任务/运行/评审单位与不确定性类型共同登记。

en.takeaway: Reconstruction fidelity and memorisation need separate treatment in tool-access governance.
en.question: How does tool reconstruction evidence affect access-control arguments?
en.design: The study evaluates reconstruction of selected scientific tools under differing information conditions. Table 2 reports best-of-three performance normalised to the original tool’s metric. This record retains high-level design, partial reconstruction and the limits of memorisation diagnostics.
findings: Some outcomes are partial reconstructions. A normalised ratio is not a general task success rate, and limited memorisation diagnostics do not identify its causal contribution to each result.
en.interpretation: An access-control case must distinguish original-tool availability, replacement fidelity and actual human uplift. One normalised score does not establish the links between them.
en.limits: The selected tools and best-of-three statistic constrain generalisation. Memorisation diagnostics offer limited evidence rather than causal attribution.
en.decisionRelevance: NUWA recommendation: Use as bounded evidence for the assumptions in a tool-access safety case; preserve normalisation and attempt selection.

zh.takeaway: 跨信息条件测试工具重建；原表为三次尝试的最佳值并相对原工具指标归一，部分成果只是局部重建。
zh.question: 限制信息访问能否阻止科研工具被重建？
zh.design: 研究在不同信息条件下测量编码智能体对选定科学工具的重建。表 2 使用三次尝试的最佳结果并相对原工具指标归一；这里只保留高层测量设计、部分重建与记忆诊断边界。
findings: 部分结果属于局部重建。相对原工具指标的归一比例不是通用任务成功率；有限的记忆诊断不能确定记忆对每项结果的因果贡献。
zh.interpretation: 访问限制的安全论证需要区分原工具可得性、替代工具保真度与实际人类增益。它们之间的推理不能由单个归一分数替代。
zh.limits: 仅限选定工具；记忆诊断为中等证据且不识别因果贡献；归一比例不是通用任务成功率。
zh.decisionRelevance: NUWA 建议：补充访问控制论证所需的重建证据，仅保留非操作性方法与边界。

en.takeaway: Initial suppression and durable safeguards are different claims.
en.question: Is initial suppression from pretraining filtering also a durable safeguard?
en.design: The authors evaluate pretraining filtering across several sizes of the ESM-2 protein language model, distinguishing initial proxy-task performance from durability under subsequent adaptation. Each model uses one training seed. Operational recovery methods are excluded from this record.
findings: Initial suppression and durability under later adaptation are distinct claims. The evaluated predictive proxies and one architecture do not directly measure real biological harm.
en.interpretation: Safeguard evidence should address selectivity, initial effect and durability. Its connection with Deep Ignorance is complementary argument structure, not independent replication on the same model.
en.limits: The study uses one architecture and one seed per trained model. Proxy prediction outcomes do not establish real biological harm or transfer to all language models.
en.decisionRelevance: NUWA recommendation: Compare safeguard scope and durability with unlearning and access-control evidence, retaining architecture and adaptation boundaries.

zh.takeaway: 作者在 ESM-2 的若干规模上区分初始能力压低与后续适应后的防护持久性。
zh.question: 预训练过滤的选择性与持久性是否一致？
zh.design: 作者在 ESM-2 蛋白语言模型的若干规模上评估预训练过滤，区分初始代理任务能力和后续适应条件下的持久性。每种模型只使用一个训练种子；本记录不展示可执行恢复方法。
findings: 初始能力压低和后续适应下的防护持久性属于不同主张；所测预测代理和单一模型架构不直接测量现实生物危害。
zh.interpretation: 防护证据需要同时回答选择性、初始效果与长期持久性。与 Deep Ignorance 的联系是论证结构上的互补，不能视为同一模型上的独立复现。
zh.limits: 每种模型单一训练种子、单架构；代理预测任务不是现实生物危害，不外推至所有大语言模型。
zh.decisionRelevance: NUWA 建议：接入 Deep Ignorance 与 unlearning 研究的范围比较；不收集可执行恢复方法。

en.takeaway: Risk management is a staged decision process rather than a benchmark threshold alone.
en.question: Which gaps remain between evaluation evidence and a deployment decision?
en.design: This reading covers only the abstract, contents and introduction on pages 1–3 of the 81-page report. Those sections organise open problems into risk planning, identification, analysis, evaluation and mitigation, separating consensus, framework and implementation barriers.
findings: The introductory map treats risk management as a staged decision process with scientific and institutional gaps. It does not provide a single benchmark threshold sufficient for deployment.
en.interpretation: The introductory map is useful for governance research discovery. Until later chapters are read, their headings should not be presented as fully checked arguments or consensus conclusions.
en.limits: Only introductory material was selected. The remainder of the report and its individual arguments have not been audited in this integration.
en.decisionRelevance: NUWA recommendation: Read the evaluation and mitigation chapters next, linking each decision claim to its own evidence and assumptions.

zh.takeaway: 按风险规划、识别、分析、评价、缓解组织开放问题，并区分共识、框架与实施层面的障碍。
zh.question: 从评测证据到部署判断还有哪些制度与科学缺口？
zh.design: 本轮只选读 81 页报告的摘要、目录及导论（第 1–3 页）。这些材料按风险规划、识别、分析、评价和缓解组织开放问题，并区分共识、框架与实施障碍。
findings: 导论地图把风险管理视为分阶段的决策过程，并指出科学与制度缺口；它没有给出足以决定部署的单一基准阈值。
zh.interpretation: 适合用作治理研究的选题入口；在未细读后续章节前，不能把目录中的主题写成已经核查的完整论证或共识结论。
zh.limits: 本轮只选读摘要、目录和导论；不声称审阅全部 81 页或所有论证。
zh.decisionRelevance: NUWA 建议：用作治理研究选题地图，下一轮重点读评价与缓解章节。
